about.title: Halor
about.intro: {project} ka long ka platform ba dei ban wan jong ka jingiaisuk fail peer-to-peer, kaba la pyndep da ki technology kaba khraw kaba khlem khat. Ka pyniaroh ka interface kaba sngewthuh suk bad ka architecture kaba khlem khat baroh, ban pynshisha ka jingiaisuk fail kaba akor bad kaba khrum khlem ban donkam ia ka authority ba khat. Kane ka project ka long open source, ka la pynmih ha ka {license}.

decentralized.title: Ka network kaba khlem khat baroh
decentralized.description: Khlem server ba khat, khlem ka pud ba kawei ba lah ban duh. Ki user ki shem bad ki skor ki content ka jong ki ha ki tymmen, khlem ban ialaitlur ha ka index ba khat, tracker, lane database.

accessControl.title: Ka jingsngew khun ki jingrwai
accessControl.description: Lano lano u briew u lah ban pyndep ka jong ka network bad ki jong ki ain khlem siar. Ha kaei kaei ka network, ki jingthung ki user ki la pynbiang: u nongbun, u administrator, u nongpynmih, u moderator, bad u nongiap-noh. Ngi don ka jingsngew khun shaphang u byno u lah ban pynmih, pynkwah bad skor noh ia ka content.

ui.title: Ka interface user ka jingbha bha
ui.description: Ka interface media center kaba thymma bad kaba pynba pat, kaba la design ia ki desktop, TV bad mobile platform. Ka jingiaid suk da ka keyboard, mouse, gamepad, lane remote control. Ki user ba ngeit ki lah ban pynkam ia ka software kum data server kaba khlem khlieh ha ka command-line interface.

dataFormat.title: Ka jingthung data ba u briew u lah ban pule
dataFormat.description: Ka jingthung data LISH ka la pyndep ha ka JSON, kaba pynsuk ban thaw, pule, bad sngewthuh. Ai-iasuk ia ka content jong phi bad ki metadata kiba dap bad kiba shai, kiba uno uno u lah ban shem suk.

security.title: Ka private bad ka security
security.description: Baroh ki jingitynnad peer-to-peer ki la pynkylla, ban pynshisha ba ki data jong phi ki long private hapoh ka transit. Ki user ki lah ban iadem da ka VPN ban donlong shuh kaba khlem dei. {project} ka pynkyrkhu ia ka private jong phi da ka design.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Ka software ka don ia Windows, Linux bad macOS. Pyndonkam ia ka ha kaei kaei ka platform kaba phi sngewdiang.

download.title: Skor noh
download.description: Shem ia {project} ia ka platform jong phi. Baroh ki jingskor-noh ki long khlem siar bad open source.
